recap.headline: Eshan's Chip Talk Meets Eighth Place
recap.subhead: Luka dropped 42 and Norman Powell watched it all from the pine, which is the story of Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw.

zingers.team: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw
zingers.line: Eshan B picked himself first and called everyone else a bag of chips, then sits eighth while Norman Powell's 18 points rot on his bench.
Caleb Wilson dropped 24 points and 4 threes on your bench while you took a 2-7 loss to Suggs to be you.
Derik Queen put up 20 on your bench, and you are tied 5-5 with BrookynDynasty, so do the math.
Cooper Flagg went 3-19 from the field and you still ran Nova Knicks off the floor 8-2, which says everything about Nova.
Alperen Sengun went 12-15 with 10 assists and you still trail Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw 6-5 because of that bench.
Giannis went for 30, 12 and 7 and MONSTARS still lead you 7-4, which is what punting points and steals gets you.
Donovan Clingan's 18 boards and 4 blocks bought you a 5-5 tie with theInfamous, so the FT% punt is leaking.

night: Luka Doncic went for 42 PTS, 13 AST, 6 3PTM on 14-24 FG for Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw, the best line of the night.
Cooper Flagg went 17 PTS, 6 AST on 3-19 FG for Suggs to be you, the worst brick of the night.
Caleb Wilson sat on Nova Knicks' bench and put up 24 PTS, 4 3PTM, 4 STL on 9-17 FG, and Derik Queen did 20 PTS for LeParth James.
Kobe Sanders scored 26 PTS with 5 3PTM on 8-17 FG, and he is still on the wire.
Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw had the best night, going 5-5-1 against Adam Silver Dez Nuts, while Nova Knicks had the worst at 2-7-2 against Suggs to be you.
